content.title: Penguin Solutions stock dives on weak outlook: CEO explains
content.description:
Penguin Solutions (PENG) stock is falling after the company reported weaker-than-expected guidance. Penguin Solutions CEO Mark Adams joins Asking for a Trend host Josh Lipton to discuss the earnings print.

content.title: Verizon-AST SpaceMobile partnership, Penguin Solutions stock falls
content.description:
Morning Brief host Julie Hyman tracks several of the day's top trending stock tickers, including Verizon Communications (VZ) inking a partnership with AST SpaceMobile (ASTS) to provide cell service from space, Penguin Solutions (PENG) shares falling in Wednesday's pre-market trading on its sales forecast, and Jefferies Financial Group (JEF) disclosing exposure to now-bankrupt auto parts manufacturer First Brands Group.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Morning Brief.
